purpose: Define one read-only canonical vocabulary for binding Control Center commands to existing Research OS engines without creating a second runtime.
rules: The registry is descriptive and must not execute work.
A registry entry does not grant authority.
Existing canonical engines remain execution authorities.
Unknown executor, observation, or evidence links are not treated as operational.
Control Center must not become a second Friend, Agent, Factory, GitHub, or Assurance engine.
Human authority remains external to observation and confidence.
